title: ever MARIEL|Side Split Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your elegance with this stunning Mother of the Bride dress! Crafted from lightweight chiffon, it features exquisite rhinestone embellishments and charming ruffle sleeves that add a touch of glamour. Perfect for the big day, this dress ensures you shine while celebrating love and family.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
